name: Activated abilities of a target — Quicksilver Elemental, Grell Philosopher
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py. The affected permanents are the ability's source (Quicksilver Elemental) or each Horror you control (Grell Philosopher); the target only says where the abilities come from (Battlefield.setRefPerm; the 'Abilities from' picker), so the effect is not moved onto the target. The abilities are locked in as the ability resolves: Prodigal Sorcerer loses its ability to Ovinize afterwards and Quicksilver Elemental keeps it. Gray Ogre is not a Horror and gains nothing.

$includes: {T}: This creature deals 1 damage to any target.
{8}, {T}: This artifact deals 4 damage to any target.

scryfallData.oracle_text: {T}: This creature deals 1 damage to any target.
scryfallData.flavor_text: "You can't learn to enjoy life's amusements in the pages of books. You must seek them out in earnest."

scryfallData.name: Quicksilver Elemental
scryfallData.oracle_text:
{U}: This creature gains all activated abilities of target creature until end of turn. (If any of the abilities use that creature's name, use this creature's name instead.)
You may spend blue mana as though it were mana of any color to pay the activation costs of this creature's abilities.

scryfallData.name: Grell Philosopher
scryfallData.oracle_text: Aberrant Tinkering — When this creature enters and at the beginning of your upkeep, each Horror you control gains all activated abilities of target artifact an opponent controls until end of turn. You may spend blue mana as though it were mana of any color to activate those abilities.
scryfallData.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate

scryfallData.name: Gray Ogre
scryfallData.flavor_text: The Ogre philosopher Gnerdel believed the purpose of life was to live as high on the food chain as possible. She refused to eat vegetarians, preferring to live entirely on creatures that preyed on sentient beings.

scryfallData.name: Ovinize
scryfallData.oracle_text: Until end of turn, target creature loses all abilities and has base power and toughness 0/1.
scryfallData.flavor_text: The crocodile's failed attack left it feeling both hungry and sheepish.
